heading.title: Parties to Notes, Bills and Cheques.

article.title: Only drawee can be acceptor except in need or for honour.
article.content: No person except the drawee of a bill exchange, or all or some of several drawees, or a person named therein as a drawee in case of need, or an acceptor for honour, can bind himself by an acceptance.
article.html:
33Only drawee can be acceptor except in need or for honour.

Section 33 · Chapter III · page 13 of the Act

No person except the drawee of a bill exchange, or all or some of several drawees, or a person named therein as a drawee in case of need, or an acceptor for honour, can bind himself by an acceptance.
